title: M5GFX #445 review: board_spec product and schematic links for CoreMatrix, Chain Captain and PaperDIY

execution.environment: macOS 26.5.1 arm64; Node v22.14.0 (downloaded official arm64 build, machine had no Node); pypdf 6.21.4; local Device Service exposes 36 profiles including paperdiy (partial, ET047TC1 540x960) but no CoreMatrix or Chain Captain profile

checks.detail: PR #445 OPEN, not draft, author ainyan03, English body, 0 comments and 0 reviews before review, mergeable MERGEABLE, base develop
5 files +28/-2, all under extras/board_spec: three boards/*.json spec.links, official_name_verified on corematrix, regenerated dist bundle, and the catalog test list

schema/board.schema.json linkSpec allows product/schematic/verified and the verified enum includes datasheet; contribution matches the convention already used by m5airq and m5atoms3; m5atom_psram is the existing precedent for links present with an unverified official name, matching how PaperDIY is kept here
all six URLs return 200; the three docs pages return text/html and the three schematic links return application/pdf (515181 / 780319 / 681339 bytes)

fetching each docs page shows the PR's three PDF URLs are exactly the schematics linked from those pages; h1 values are CoreMatrix, Chain Captain, PaperDIY Complete Kit; SKUs on the pages are C158, C160, K159-B

npm run bundle at head rewrites dist/board_spec_editor.html and git status --porcelain is empty, so the committed bundle is byte-identical to a fresh build; each of the six new URLs appears exactly once in the bundle
node cli/spec.js check -> 'check passed: 63 board(s), 90 resolved combination(s)'
npm test at head: 221 tests, 220 pass, 1 fail; the only failure is 'M5Unified live pin tables match generated values' (case 47), caused by the local M5Unified checkout being a 2026-11-06 snapshot

same suite at base 5873de4: 221 tests, 220 pass, 1 fail, the identical case 47; compare-pintable reports only m5stampp4xhub in_i2c_scl/sda 1/0 vs 255/255, none of the three touched boards, so the failure is pre-existing environment drift and this PR is test-neutral
gh pr checks: 'Catalog and generated sources' SUCCESS; Arduino and ESP-IDF matrix jobs mostly SUCCESS with a handful still pending at review time; no failure

CoreMatrix V0.7 is readable in the drawing text; Chain Captain V0.6 and PaperDIY K159-B are supported only by the official docs page filenames because the PDF title blocks are rotated vector text that pypdf cannot extract
no CoreMatrix / Chain Captain / PaperDIY hardware available, and the diff contains no device-observable behavior

the local Device Service does expose a paperdiy profile (partial, ET047TC1 540x960), but extras/board_spec link metadata never enters the firmware runtime path, so a booted virtual device could not observe this diff; skipped by nature of the change, not for lack of a profile
the generated editor page was not opened in a real browser; the link escaping / javascript: rejection cases inside npm test do pass

notes: Verdict: no blocking issues; can be merged along the author's direction.
PR left OPEN; a single English comment posted; no close, no push, no change to m5stack/M5GFX.
Evidence class is host-level test plus live link verification. Hardware and virtual-device validation are NOT RUN because the change is catalog metadata with no runtime path.
